No pricing option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your **monthly churn rate < 4%** limit.

- The comparison is otherwise robust under the changes tested, but it assumes that higher MRR is the goal; that objective direction was not explicitly stated.
- Four inputs were supplied by Olumi rather than by you, including active subscribers, new subscribers, churn, and feature-release value, so the result remains provisional.
- The unscored churn constraint needs to be attached to the specific modelled measure it is intended to limit; simply restating the 4% threshold would not make it testable.
